description: This Python script automates the generation of documentation for a project, cloning repositories, creating mkdocs configuration, and deploying documentation.

classes.name: MkdocsYamlFileGenerator
classes.description: Generates mkdocs YAML configuration files for documentation structure.

classes.name: DocumentGenerator
classes.description: Main class that manages repository cloning, documentation generation, and deployment.

methods.name: is_branch_name_valid
methods.description: Validates the branch name against semantic versioning pattern.

methods.name: clean_all_repos_dir
methods.description: Removes existing repository directories to prepare for fresh clone.

methods.name: clone_all_repos
methods.description: Clones all required repositories based on URLs and branch info.

methods.name: clone_repo
methods.description: Clones a specific repository and returns commit ID and date.

methods.name: mkdocs_create_index_file
methods.description: Creates the main index.md file for mkdocs documentation.

methods.name: add_topic
methods.description: Adds a documentation topic and its subtopics to the YAML configuration.

methods.name: to_markdown
methods.description: Generates markdown documentation from JSON interface files.

methods.name: complete_yaml_creation
methods.description: Finalizes and writes the YAML configuration file.
